transactioncolumncustomfield.description: Ownership marker written by Landed Cost Management onto the Vendor Bill lines it generates. Format: LCM<record id>::<merge key>. It is what proves a line was created by a given LCM record, so appending and repairing can rewrite or remove only their own lines. Do not edit or clear it by hand.
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: Set automatically by the Landed Cost Management scripts. A blank value on a landed-cost line means the line predates this marker, or was not created by Landed Cost Management.
transactioncolumncustomfield.label: LCM Source Key
